sentences.quote: He has been the chief executive officer of Monster Beverage since June 2025 and the vice chairman and president since 1990.
sentences.text: He has been a director and vice chairman of the board since November 1990, served as president, chief operating officer and secretary from 1990 to January 2021, and was chief financial officer from July 1996 to January 2021.
In January 2021 he was elected co-chief executive officer alongside Sacks, who had led the company since 1990.
From June 13, 2025 he became sole chief executive officer, with Sacks remaining chairman.
